records.title: Learning Long-Range Dependencies with Temporal Predictive Coding
records.reason: Temporal predictive coding studies online recurrent learning, with neuromorphic/edge motivation, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Sparse Selective Hyper-Connections: A Unified Framework for Stable and Efficient Deep Residual Learning
records.reason: Primary IEEE DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/SoutheastCon63549.2026.11476522 was inaccessible. The abstract describes sparse residual hyper-connections and a claimed KV-cache-compression connection, but the method/evaluation/limitations could not be verified.

records.title: Practical Python FPGA Acceleration with Fast Just-In-Time Compilation and Configuration
records.reason: Primary ACM DOI https://doi.org/10.1145/3797265 returned 403/internal error. The abstract describes Python-to-FPGA JIT acceleration; full text was unavailable to evaluate the linked inference-systems connection.

records.title: SpectraNet: a novel model for polyp segmentation leveraging a spectral-guided mixture of functional experts
records.reason: The full Frontiers paper proposes spectral boundary enhancement and function-specialized MoE for medical polyp segmentation, reporting segmentation scores and 15.04 FPS. Its MoE is task-specific image segmentation; it has no language-model inference/serving connection.

records.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of LLMs with Mixture of Space Experts
records.reason: MoSLoRA applies a mixture of geometric spaces to parameter-efficient LLM fine-tuning and proposes lightweight routing/space mapping to reduce non-Euclidean operation overhead. Experiments are downstream fine-tuning/task-quality results, not inference-time latency/memory/throughput; relevance is training-adaptation adjacent.
